replies.author: @crazytrain03
replies.text:
Yeah, na. You might not know this, because you don't know everything......but I was born in the swamps of North Western Florida. I was also stationed in the high desert of California/Nevada for years afterward. Two different heats, yes......but one will make your life suck, and the other will end it.

Humidity heat is like walking into a sauna.....it's hot, muggy, you sweat a lot and it makes you tired.

Dry high altitude heat, is like stepping into an industrial oven. Its painfully hot, rapidly evaporating your sweat so you can't naturally cool, and then out paces water intake, that eventual exposure will take your life. I've seen a half dozen soldiers have a flag draped over their caskets from dry heat......not a single one from humid heat. 🤷 

I've lived in 12 states and most of them being in the humid, hot deep south.....I'm in Louisiana right now even 🤷 dry heat is far worse for your health
